owner.description: Name of the action item owner, only when explicitly stated together with the action; otherwise null.
owner.title: Owner

due_date.description: Due date or deadline for the action item, only when explicitly stated together with the action; otherwise null.
due_date.title: Due Date

uncertainty_reason.description: Explanation of why owner or due date is null when missing or ambiguous.
uncertainty_reason.title: Uncertainty Reason

citations.description: Citation strings supporting the action item; at least one citation is required.
citations.title: Citations

citations.description: Citation strings supporting the agenda-vs-meeting disagreement, citing both the agenda page and the audio segment.
citations.title: Citations

statement.description: Clear, self-contained description of what was decided
statement.title: Statement

citations.description: Citation strings pointing at the audio segment where the decision was stated
citations.title: Citations

name.description: Participant name from the supplied participant list
name.title: Name

role.description: Participant role from the supplied participant list
role.title: Role

discussion_summary.description: Concise summary of what was actually said for the topic, not the agenda's proposed framing.
discussion_summary.title: Discussion Summary

citations.description: Citation strings supporting the unresolved issue
citations.title: Citations

description: Extraction model for MeetingRecord with repeated topics, decisions, action_items, unresolved_issues, conflicts, participants

meeting_id.description: Read directly from the meeting metadata available in the transcript/agenda.
meeting_id.title: Meeting Id

title.description: Read directly from the meeting metadata available in the transcript/agenda.
title.title: Title

meeting_date.description: Read directly from the meeting metadata available in the transcript/agenda.
meeting_date.title: Meeting Date

start_time.description: Read directly from the meeting metadata available in the transcript/agenda.
start_time.title: Start Time

end_time.description: Read directly from the meeting metadata available in the transcript/agenda.
end_time.title: End Time

review_status.description: Always set to the fixed literal pending_review.
review_status.title: Review Status

topics.description: One entry per agenda or discussion topic actually covered in the meeting, including discussion summary.
topics.title: Topics

decisions.description: One entry per explicit spoken decision confirmed in the meeting transcript, with citations.
decisions.title: Decisions

action_items.description: Concrete follow-up tasks discussed in the meeting, with owner and due date only when explicitly stated, plus citations and uncertainty reason when needed.
action_items.title: Action Items

unresolved_issues.description: Items explicitly left open, pending, or deferred, each with at least one citation.
unresolved_issues.title: Unresolved Issues

conflicts.description: Agenda-versus-meeting disagreements, citing both agenda page evidence and audio evidence.
conflicts.title: Conflicts

participants.description: Use the supplied participant list as the authoritative source of participant names and roles.
participants.title: Participants

title: MeetingRecord_Extraction
